name: deepscientist-lite-engineering
description: Auditable numerical, signal-processing, simulation, and research-figure analyses for DeepScientist Lite.

interface.longDescription: An experimental engineering pack for Python, MATLAB, or Octave numerical work. One router records units, sampling, preprocessing, FFT choices, seeds, commands, figures, and evidence while forcing aliasing, leakage, dimension, and axis checks.
defaultPrompt: Use $ds-lite-engineering to specify or audit one bounded numerical or signal-processing analysis.
